title: Update/produce required marketplace screenshots + diagrams (AWS/GCP) w/ redaction + consistent UI state
creator: Soojin Lee
description: We need a refreshed, consistent set of screenshots and diagrams for AWS + GCP Marketplace listings + attachments. Assets must reflect the updated purchase→provisioning flow (org linking wizard + entitlement status), align with final messaging, and be safe to share publicly (no PII, no internal IDs, no secrets). This ticket owns producing/updating the final visuals, coordinating reviews (PMM + Security), and delivering an approved asset bundle to Partnerships/Marketing for submission.
body:
## Background
AWS/GCP Marketplace reviews frequently kick back listings for inconsistent UI states, unclear activation steps, or screenshots that appear to contain sensitive information. For this refresh, visuals are part of the buyer trust motion (security posture + clear onboarding) and must match the new SKU taxonomy and Console onboarding wizard.

Primary consumers:
- AWS Marketplace listing page (gallery + long description)
- GCP Marketplace solution page (graphics + deployment steps)
- Listing attachments (security packet references, diagrams)
- Sales enablement (internal deck + talk tracks)

## Deliverables (final assets)
### A) Screenshots (Console)
1) Marketplace onboarding entry point (Console landing / banner / CTA)
   - Shows: “Purchased via AWS/GCP Marketplace?” entry and what info is needed.
2) Org linking wizard (step 1)
   - Shows: selecting an existing org vs creating a new org.
   - Must not display real customer names.
3) Entitlement status page (success state)
   - Shows: cloud marketplace provider, SKU name, entitlement active, region(s), and a clear next step (create API key / start using endpoint).
4) Entitlement status page (pending / delayed state)
   - Shows: “Activation pending” with expected delay messaging + support link.
   - Avoid including internal incident links or internal runbook URLs.
5) Usage/cost analytics screenshot (safe view)
   - Shows: token-level cost/latency breakdown at a high level (no real prompts, no customer data).
   - Use synthetic usage data.

### B) Screenshots (Docs / onboarding)
6) Docs page hero/intro screenshot (AWS purchase → console link → org linking)
7) Docs page hero/intro screenshot (GCP flow + any noted differences)

### C) Diagrams
8) Purchase → entitlement → provisioning flow diagram
   - High-level swimlane (Customer → AWS/GCP Marketplace → Redwood entitlement service → Redwood Console).
   - Must include common edge cases at a conceptual level (e.g., “wrong org linked”, “region mismatch”) without exposing internal system names.
9) Security architecture diagram (public-safe)
   - Data flow: customer request → Redwood edge → model serving plane; show encryption in transit + encryption at rest, audit logging, and key management hooks (KMS/HSM as “integrations supported”).
   - Use language that matches Security FAQ (no over-claims).

## Asset requirements / constraints
- Format:
  - PNG for screenshots (preferred), SVG/PDF for diagrams; also export PNG versions for marketplaces that don’t accept SVG.
  - 16:9 and 4:3 crops as needed (AWS gallery vs GCP formatting differences).
- Visual consistency:
  - Use Light mode only.
  - Use the same demo org name across all images: “Redwood Demo Org”.
  - Use consistent region naming: “us-east-1” and “europe-west4” only where needed.
  - Use the final SKU naming (per PM-873 outputs). If naming is not final, leave in a neutral label and re-capture once final.
- Redaction & safety:
  - No emails, API keys, tokens, account IDs, entitlement IDs, invoice IDs.
  - No customer names/logos.
  - If a field must exist in UI for realism (e.g., an org ID), blur it or replace via demo environment.
  - Ensure any URL in the address bar is either hidden or shows a public-safe hostname only.

## Production plan
1) Confirm list of required images with Partnerships + PMM
   - Source of truth: marketplace screenshot inventory doc (Drive) + listing drafts.
2) Capture in staging with demo data
   - Coordinate with Eng (Console) to ensure wizard/entitlement states are available via fixtures.
3) Produce diagrams in Figma
   - Reuse the iconography/typography from Redwood brand kit.
4) Redaction pass
   - First pass: owner (Design/Docs)
   - Second pass: Security (Marcus Lin) for “safe to share publicly”
5) Final exports + handoff
   - Deliver as a single folder with clear filenames and a short README.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All screenshots reflect the current Console UI (post DES-211/ENG-4403 changes) and are internally consistent (same org name, same style, no mixed states).
- [ ] Redaction confirmed: no PII, no secrets, no internal-only identifiers.
- [ ] Diagrams match approved security wording (no claims like “SOC2 certified” unless explicitly approved in Security FAQ).
- [ ] PMM sign-off (Soojin) and Security sign-off (Marcus) recorded in comments.
- [ ] Asset bundle delivered to Partnerships with filenames + intended placement (AWS vs GCP).

## Open questions
- Do we want to show a Dedicated capacity dashboard in public screenshots, or keep visuals focused on Hosted onboarding to avoid procurement confusion?
- For the security diagram: do we depict “Private (VPC/on-prem)” as a separate deployment box, or keep it generic and reference it in text only?

## Handoff format
- Folder name: `marketplace-refresh_visuals_2026-02-XX/`
- Filenames (example):
  - `aws_gallery_01_console_marketplace_entry.png`
  - `aws_gallery_02_org_linking_step1.png`
  - `aws_gallery_03_entitlement_active.png`
  - `aws_gallery_04_entitlement_pending.png`
  - `gcp_graphic_01_marketplace_onboarding_overview.png`
  - `diagram_purchase_to_provisioning_flow_v3.pdf`
  - `diagram_security_architecture_publicsafe_v2.pdf`
- Include `README.txt` listing where each asset is used (AWS listing section, GCP listing section, docs page).
